description: This file defines the LookupTableService class, which provides methods for retrieving and creating lookup tables in the system. It utilizes security context for authentication and interacts with the LookupTableRepository to perform database operations.

classes.name: LookupTableService
classes.description: Service class responsible for operations related to LookupTable objects, including retrieval by key or survey, and creation of new lookup tables.

methods.name: findByKey
methods.description: Retrieves a list of LookupTable objects matching the provided key after authenticating the user.

methods.name: findBySurvey
methods.description: Retrieves a list of LookupTable objects associated with a specific survey after authenticating the user.

methods.name: createLookupTable
methods.description: Creates and saves a list of LookupTable objects after authenticating the user.
